info.title: dbdeploy
info.description: dbdeploy is a cli tool to manage database migrations. It supports deployments, rollbacks, multiple branches, creation of databases. It works on Windows, Linux and Mac

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates scripts filenames and csv files.

options.description: Path of directory containing databases scripts (defaults to current directory)

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Runs a set of deploy scripts to one or more databases

options.name: --path
options.description: Path of directory containing databases scripts (defaults to current directory)

options.name: --branch
options.description: Name of branch to deploy (defaults to 'main' or the default branch name set in the global settings)

options.name: --dryrun
options.description: Enable to test what scripts needs to be deployed without actually running them

options.name: --test
options.description: Enable deployments of test scripts [default: False]

options.name: --create
options.description: Enable creation of the database if the database does not exists [default: False]

options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
